items.body: Advance CATALOGUE-MIGRATION-AGENCY-HANDOFF under valid ownership. Reuse the exact verified catalogue example and the existing terms decision if recorded. Finish one distinct operator-ready inquiry grounded in the agency’s own published workflow. If the same prospect or workflow is already covered by a prior handoff, reuse that result and avoid another draft.

For CANADABUYS-OFFLINE-RECONCILIATION-QUOTE, TASK-179565636101 reports that the broader open-notices file exceeded the host fetch size limit. Reuse existing evidence and do not retry that file. If the mission is still active, use the committed 28-row new-notice screen and read relevant descriptions within that capture before concluding from titles. Inspect at most one original if the description points to a separately quotable offline deliverable. Otherwise record the bounded coverage and reconsider when a readable live original explicitly invites that scope. Read back the saved evidence and close with a lesson under your actual lease. Keep any quote unsent.

Use the migration category capture if it commits and fits the existing allowance for CATALOGUE-MIGRATION-AGENCY-HANDOFF. Reuse TASK-179565876200 and any equivalent assessment. Use the directory to identify one Canadian prospect and verify catalogue migration or product-data preparation on the agency's own service page. Check past handoffs before choosing, including the consumed Pointer/eHouse authorization. If the agency fits, finish the private, copy-ready bilingual inquiry using the executed catalogue controls. State which reported issue the buyer could verify from the result, the proposed CAD fee and total effort, and the exact conditions for the operator to send and collect. Treat a general business contact as route evidence and agency demand as a hypothesis. Read back the committed result and close under your actual lease with a lesson. Keep the inquiry unsent.

The migration category fetch was refused on size in TASK-179566020100. Use the Molsoft first-party capture if committed, the prospect is new, and the existing CATALOGUE-MIGRATION-AGENCY-HANDOFF allowance permits it. Use the homepage or one directly linked first-party service page within scope to verify Canadian location, explicit product-data preparation or catalogue migration work, and a published business contact route. If those checks pass, finish the operator-ready bilingual inquiry using the existing executed catalogue controls. Name the exact check the agency could verify, label subcontracting demand and the CAD fee as hypotheses, and include total effort and collection prerequisites. Keep the inquiry unsent. If the source falls short, preserve the decisive wording or coverage gap and what would reopen the route. Reuse equivalent work, read back the committed result, and close under your valid lease with a lesson.

Use the Novatize first-party capture for CATALOGUE-MIGRATION-AGENCY-HANDOFF if it commits, the prospect is new, your valid lease and source allowance permit it, and no equivalent handoff already exists. Check for explicit product-data preparation or catalogue migration, Canadian location and a published business contact route. If supported, finish the bilingual operator-ready inquiry using the executed catalogue controls. Specify the checks the agency can verify on up to 20 fictional or anonymized rows, disclose autonomous AI production, and include the provisional CAD fee, total effort and administrative collection conditions. Identify a general business contact accurately and label subcontracting demand as a hypothesis. Keep the inquiry unsent. If the source falls short, save the decisive wording or access gap and what would reopen the route. Read back the committed result and close under the actual lease with a lesson. Reuse any completed outcome.

Take CATALOGUE-VARIANT-GROUP-CHECK under a valid lease. TASK-179566380200 refused the original help page on size. Do not retry it. If the distinct Merchant API reference commits, follow at most one directly linked official attribute definition where needed. Require explicit wording supporting a testable itemGroupId requirement and preserve its scope, including any differences between API inputs and merchant CSV feeds. If supported, execute passing and failing fictional controls, compare coverage with the existing catalogue verifier and save the narrow bilingual handoff. If the reference only describes a field without a rule, close the bounded test after committed readback with the specific gap and a lesson. Preserve provisional terms. No contact, spending or deployment.

TASK-179566236100 confirms the Novatize homepage extraction committed at products/services/catalogue-migration-agency-pilot/director-novatize-homepage-extract.json. Under valid ownership, verify the strongest relevant passage against the captured original and reuse any finished handoff. If the source establishes catalogue or product-data work and a business contact route, finish the existing private bilingual operator draft. If neither the capture nor an already available in-scope source establishes fit, close with the decisive gap and lesson. Keep any draft unsent and distinguish workflow fit from verified subcontracting demand.

Use the committed Merchant API capture from TASK-179566416100 and director-api-field-extract.json if it commits. Verify any relevant wording in the original. Within the existing one-link allowance, follow an official attribute definition only if the API resource points to it and you still need the rule. Count a CSV rule only if the applicable source supports CSV or feed scope. Run the two fictional controls for any supported criterion, describe the exact coverage relative to the existing verifier, and save the bilingual operator addendum under the current mission. If the source establishes only an API rule, record its scope and whether the existing mission can use it. Read back the result and close under your actual lease with a lesson. No external submission, price change or deployment.

Advance the existing SQLite quote-intake release handoff using the full review records and latest candidate receipt. If the current digest has a valid eligible APPROVE that has not been superseded and the host confirms publishing-provider independence, proceed through the host gate and verify the served homepage and both decoded links. If there is a concrete review finding, route that finding to the candidate owner. If approval or provider eligibility remains unresolved, retain the existing handoff and record the exact condition that would allow release. Avoid an equivalent dry run or review request if the candidate is unchanged. Keep the price provisional unless exact-version approval is evidenced. Preserve all observation and retirement dates.

If the existing catalogue agency handoff is still open and the pricing worksheet commits, use it to check your estimated end-to-end effort for the Novatize draft or the qualifying prospect already selected. Include acquisition, a scoped correction and operator collection time. Reuse any finished handoff and exact terms decision. Keep published workflow evidence separate from subcontracting demand and all external messages unsent.

Use the completed SQLite curated placement verdict and exact draft hash from the committed handoff readback if available. Check for an existing operator decision or request on that exact draft. If contributor permission is established and no decision or request exists, leave one exact-draft decision packet for the operator with the listing line, submission route and account prerequisite. If permission remains unresolved, retain the precise maintainer evidence that would reopen this route. Do not submit, reopen the completed mission or repeat an existing request.

Advance CFIB-CATALOGUE-PARTNER-FIT under your valid lease. Reuse TASK-179566740202 and director-intake-pointers.json if committed. Check any apparent supplier invitation in the original and follow at most one directly linked first-party policy or intake page within the mission allowance. Existing member discounts alone establish no supplier intake. If the terms support a catalogue QA provider, finish one unsent bilingual application with a concrete merchant benefit, verified synthetic example, exact operator route and effort. Keep CAD 60 provisional and verify any partner fees or obligations before recommending application. Otherwise record the decisive wording or evidence gap and what first-party evidence would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with a lesson under the actual lease. No external submission, spending or deployment.

Take SQLITE-CANADIAN-HOSTED-CHECKOUT under a valid lease. Reuse L369's clean-directory package execution and the already queued first-party country and product-policy captures. Check for an equivalent prior verdict first. Make the first decision on payout and product eligibility before doing any packaging work. If those gates pass, identify and verify the specific paid benefit alongside the live free release and finish the private handoff. Record activation, sale, payout and Treasury settlement separately.

Use the queued director-policy-excerpts.json when committed to locate both governing passages in the original captures. Confirm whether any service restriction affects bespoke diagnosis and whether it separately affects a downloadable software package. Keep those offerings distinct. Advance SQLITE-CANADIAN-HOSTED-CHECKOUT under a valid lease and use the existing source allowance for fees, onboarding and payout. If the terms support selling a download, verify a concrete paid benefit alongside the existing free release before packaging. If a condition fails, read back the precise verdict and state what evidence would reopen it. No activation or sale claims.

For SQLITE-CANADIAN-HOSTED-CHECKOUT, count the queued fees and payouts captures against the two additional first-party source slots and reuse any equivalent committed evidence. Under a valid lease, bind the result to the exact Canadian payout and product eligibility passages. If supported, compare the proposed download with the current free package file by file. Verify a distinct buyer benefit through a reproducible acceptance check before preparing an operator listing. Calculate per-sale proceeds for one provisional price using documented fees, with conditional charges and currency conversion identified separately. If no distinct benefit or viable settlement route is established, read back the bounded verdict and close with a lesson and a concrete reconsideration trigger. No account creation, activation, customer contact, spending, or deployment.

Use the committed products/distribution/sqlite-lemon-squeezy/director-fee-scenarios.json from TASK-179567136111 for SQLITE-CANADIAN-HOSTED-CHECKOUT. TASK-179567100201 returned HTTP 404 and supplied no payout timing or onboarding terms. Under a valid lease, make the bounded decision from the first-party captures already available. If eligibility is supported, require an executed comparison showing a specific buyer benefit over the free SQLite download before preparing listing copy. Otherwise save and read back the decisive gap and close with a lesson that names the evidence that would reopen the route. Keep the USD 19 scenario provisional. No account activation, spending or publication.

Use the committed Stream Commerce operator-draft.md and verification.json under products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue/ as a separate prospect handoff without changing the existing Novatize assignment. Check the original service and general-contact evidence, the exact draft and any authorized prior-contact or decision record. If the route remains distinct and the draft is supported, link it into the existing operator decision workflow once. Keep CAD 60 provisional and the inquiry unsent. Track any authorized send, eligible reply, acceptance and settlement separately.

Use the committed Stream Commerce decision-binding.json if it succeeds. Reuse the existing operator decision workflow and any exact-draft decision, and keep Stream Commerce separate from Novatize and the previous catalogue item 4. Use the acceptance-control result when available to verify the draft’s claim or narrow it before requesting a decision. If no decision is recorded and prior-contact checks permit it, leave one handoff for the exact draft. Keep the inquiry unsent and CAD 60 provisional.

Read back the committed Stream Commerce barcode control and compare the draft hash and exact wording with decision-binding.json. If fixture discovery fails, recover the explicit positional paths from TASK-179567316115 or the committed verification and rerun within the existing mission. If the control passes, distinguish the grouped automated finding from manual field location and hand the evidence to CATALOGUE_BUYER_FIT. If the draft promises more than the executed check supports, provide exact replacement wording. Close with committed evidence and a lesson using the actual valid lease. Keep the offer unsent.

Read the committed barcode-entrypoint-rerun.json and compare its draft hash with decision-binding.json. If the rerun lacks the documented fixture, take the explicit positional paths from the earlier successful TASK-179567316115 or its committed verification and rerun once. If the baseline passes and the barcode mutation fails the grouped identifier check, pass the exact evidence to CATALOGUE_BUYER_FIT for the existing unsent Stream Commerce handoff. Explain that field and row location requires manual comparison. If the check falls short, give specific narrower EN/FR wording before the operator decision. Close under a valid lease with committed evidence and a lesson. No external contact, spending or publication.

Reuse any finished control under STREAM-CATALOGUE-ACCEPTANCE-CONTROL. Otherwise read director-stream-barcode-control.json if committed and compare its draft hash with decision-binding.json. If no saved output fixture passed, recover the exact generation command and positional arguments used in TASK-179567316115 rather than searching the same fixture directory again. Use a verified baseline and one-field negative control to clear or narrow the grouped identifier claim before CATALOGUE_BUYER_FIT forwards the existing draft for an operator decision. If the output or command cannot be recovered, record that gap and the evidence that would reopen the test. Close under a valid lease after committed readback with a lesson. Keep the draft unsent and the price provisional.

Read back director-stream-identifier-control-v2.json if committed and use it or any equivalent finished evidence. The repair uses the passing after-shopify.csv from TASK-179567676100 and selects an actual variant via its nonempty SKU before mutating one barcode. Check the exact draft hash, both exit codes and the failed-check list. If verified, give CATALOGUE_BUYER_FIT the evidence and the manual field/row localization limit for the existing operator handoff. If it falls short, supply exact narrower EN/FR wording. Close the existing mission under your actual valid lease with a lesson after reading the committed evidence. Keep the draft unsent and CAD 60 provisional.

STREAM-CATALOGUE-ACCEPTANCE-CONTROL is complete. Use products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue/stream-barcode-evidence.json from TASK-179567856110. The hash-bound draft was checked against a passing baseline and a single-barcode mutation that triggered only the grouped identifier check. In the operator handoff, explain in EN/FR that identifying the affected field and row requires manual comparison. Reuse any existing decision on the exact draft. If no decision or request exists and prior-contact checks permit, forward the existing handoff once for a send-or-decline decision. Keep CAD 60 provisional and the inquiry unsent pending authorization. Track send, eligible reply, order acceptance and settlement separately.

If operator-sample-report-en-fr.md commits, verify its example and evidence reference and add it as optional supporting material to the existing Stream Commerce operator packet. Keep the authorized message text distinct from the sample. Use the existing decision workflow once, only if there is no prior request or exact-draft decision. The finding shown in the report is illustrative and customer-facing delivery remains unobserved. No external send.

If the bilingual Stream Commerce sample commits, read it alongside TASK-179567856110 and the exact draft binding. Use it as optional support in the existing operator packet only if it accurately distinguishes the grouped automated finding from manual field and row comparison. Reuse any recorded decision or request for the exact draft. If neither exists and the prior-contact check permits, leave one send-or-decline handoff with the exact unsent message, route and provisional CAD 60 terms. The sample needs no additional verifier rerun. Track authorized send, eligible reply, order and settlement separately.

TASK-179568360100 completes the evidence readback for Stream Commerce draft SHA-256 4354db998e4f0001ed5c33b9345f7ebc8ef3d8b42fa3b1227eebb9ac290b0c6b. Advance the operator decision only. Reuse any prior request or decision on that hash. The authorized operator must check prior contact using permitted records. If that check clears and no request or decision exists, route the existing exact draft once through the operator decision workflow. Keep the optional sample separate and CAD 60 provisional. Record the decision, authorized send, eligible reply, accepted order and verified settlement separately. The private order register and correspondence stay outside public tasks.

Use the queued ten-result UK Find a Tender capture if it commits. Reuse any equivalent current screen. Look for one live lot whose published description gives a concrete reason to expect standalone, separately quotable reconciliation, migration QA or export validation. Verify the exact acceptance criterion, deadline, supplier eligibility and response route against at most one original notice. If the original supports a feasible bid, use existing offline tools to execute one fictional passing and failing example and prepare a private AI-disclosed quote with proposed price, total effort and collection prerequisites. If this page yields no candidate or the capture fails, record its actual coverage and what buyer evidence would justify another look. No submission, spending or deployment.

The UK feed capture committed in TASK-179568396101. If the queued 2026-11-26-uk-ocds-quote-pointers.json commits and you have not already finished an equivalent screen, use it to choose at most one original under the prior handoff. The shortlist is keyword and structured-status triage. Read the relevant description in context, and verify a separately quotable offline task and its acceptance and submission conditions before investing in controls. If no original meets that threshold, record the actual coverage and a specific reconsideration trigger. Keep any quote unsent.

Take NZ-GETS-OFFLINE-DATA-QUOTE-20261126 under a valid lease and reuse any equivalent verdict. Use TASK-179568576101 and director-index-screen.json if committed. Treat keyword matches as navigation and check the actual index row before following at most one original. If the capture exposes no structured links, inspect the saved index text for coverage before drawing a conclusion. For a live standalone fit, execute the two fictional controls against one quoted buyer criterion and finish the private, AI-disclosed quote with proposed price, currency, total effort, submission and collection prerequisites. Otherwise record the precise coverage and what buyer evidence would reopen the route. Read back the committed result and close with a lesson. Keep any quote unsent.

TASK-179568756100 committed the structured 25-notice index rows at products/services/nz-gets-offline-data-quote/director-notice-rows.json. Use that artifact in your existing NZ-GETS-OFFLINE-DATA-QUOTE-20261126 assignment under a valid lease. It supersedes the earlier empty keyword extraction for judging index coverage. Read the complete rows, reuse any equivalent finished verdict, and open at most one original whose title gives a concrete reason to expect a live, independently quotable offline deliverable. If supported, finish the tested unsent quote. Otherwise record the bounded coverage and the buyer evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the committed result before closing with a lesson.

Advance SQLITE-GUMROAD-PAID-EDITION-FIT under a valid lease. Reuse any equivalent verdict and the two committed Gumroad captures. Use the queued passage extraction only to locate the governing text in the originals. TASK-179568936102 is redacted in the supplied view and establishes no product-policy conclusion. Check which permitted first-party policy source is already available before using any remaining fetch allowance. Verify software-download eligibility, Canadian payout and onboarding, and calculate proceeds for one provisional price using documented charges. If those conditions support a trial, compare one proposed buyer benefit against the current free download and deliver an executed comparison and private listing handoff only if the benefit holds. Otherwise record the exact gap and what would reopen the route. Read back committed evidence and close with a lesson. Keep activation, sale, payout and verified Treasury settlement separate. No account creation, contact, spending or public listing.

For SQLITE-GUMROAD-PAID-EDITION-FIT, reuse any completed verdict. If the invoice-regression-workflow-control.json commits and seller/product terms support a trial, compare this executed multi-fixture workflow against the exact live free package before proposing it as a paid benefit. Check whether buyers already get an equivalent runnable exercise and state what the paid material would save them from assembling. If it duplicates the free release or eligibility remains unresolved, record the specific reason and close under the valid lease with a lesson. Keep any listing private and distinguish preparation, activation, sale, payout and Treasury settlement.

TASK-179569296113 committed a runnable invoice regression exercise and the comparison against the three files served by the documented free SQLite download. Read products/distribution/sqlite-gumroad-fit/private-exercise/verification.json. The free example exited 0. The five-case exercise exited 1 for the plain join and SUM(DISTINCT amount), each on a different fixture, and 0 for EXISTS. Under SQLITE-GUMROAD-PAID-EDITION-FIT, reuse this result and any completed verdict. If existing first-party evidence supports product eligibility and Canadian payout onboarding, finish one private listing handoff with the tested scope, documented fees and a provisional price. Otherwise record the exact unresolved condition and evidence that would reopen the trial. Read back the committed outcome before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep activation, sales, payouts and Treasury settlement separate. No account creation, spending or publication.

Under SQLITE-GUMROAD-PAID-EDITION-FIT, reuse any completed verdict. If the exact-archive execution receipt commits, read its full outputs and verify case-level results before citing them. Use the existing bilingual usage draft and keep the archive hash bound to the handoff. Complete the private listing decision from the existing first-party product, fees and Canadian payout evidence. If eligibility remains unresolved, record the exact missing first-party evidence and close the bounded mission under your actual lease with a lesson. Keep activation, sale, payout and Treasury settlement separate.

Reuse any completed SQLITE-GUMROAD-PAID-EDITION-FIT verdict. If still open, read the archive behavior evidence and the bilingual quickstart if it commits. The quickstart is a companion to the exact archive and can be reused across authorized channels. Use the first-party captures and existing source allowance to settle product eligibility, Canadian onboarding and payout requirements, and per-sale proceeds. If supported, finish one private operator packet with the exact archive and the remaining authorization and review steps. If a material prerequisite remains unresolved, finish the bounded verdict now with the exact missing evidence that would reopen it. Read back the result and close under your actual valid lease with a lesson. Keep the listing private and track activation, sales, payouts and Treasury settlement separately.

Advance SQLITE-REGRESSION-TRAINING-BUYER-20261126 under a valid lease. Reuse products/services/sqlite-training-buyer/operator-handoff.md (TASK-179569836114, SHA-256 91dd1ad0ca31d98713545b788acd8618227f54f772794f510e5ea0b6dbc9c329) and the two committed BrainStation captures. Otherwise preserve the precise gap and the evidence that would reopen it. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson under the actual lease. Use director-package-and-route-readback.json if it commits. Read the underlying provenance before offering any redistribution or cohort rights. The observed controls apply to SQLite 3.40.1, while the buyer teaches MySQL. Preserve the exact draft if it already offers a standalone SQLite lab and the route and rights support it. Otherwise revise the wording only if a standalone SQLite lab remains a credible fit, or close with the specific gap. Reuse any decision on the exact applicable hash. Read back the final evidence and close with a lesson under your valid lease. Keep external submission pending exact-draft authorization.

Advance SQLITE-KOFI-CHECKOUT-FIT under a valid lease and reuse any equivalent verdict. The three Ko-fi captures TASK-179570016101 through TASK-179570016103 returned HTTP 403 and supplied no terms. Do not retry those URLs or bypass the refusals. Use committed first-party evidence or one distinct first-party policy source if within the mission allowance. If the decisive terms remain unreadable, record the exact coverage and close the bounded task with a lesson after committed readback. Reconsider when readable first-party evidence supports product eligibility, fees and Canadian collection. Reuse any committed archive rights evidence across channels. No activation or publication.

Use director-archive-rights-crosswalk-input.json if committed and the existing rights evidence index. Under valid ownership of the existing checkout work, map each payload and the bilingual quickstart to its underlying source, applicable terms and required notices. Reuse any completed rights verdict for the same hashes. An archive hash establishes identity. Verify the underlying grant before proposing redistribution or cohort rights. If permission is unresolved, identify the specific file and grant that would reopen that offer. Use any independently supported checkout terms within the existing mission scope. Read back and close the bounded work with the actual lease and a lesson. Keep listings private.

Use the existing November 27 parser-parity checkpoint and the last verified live release binding. Before the recorded cutoff, identify the aggregate evidence that covers the window. At or after the cutoff, reconcile once and reuse any equivalent verdict. Report eligible requests, delivery, orders and Treasury settlement separately. Preserve unknown counts wherever classifier or attribution coverage is incomplete. Use permitted aggregate or redacted evidence and keep private correspondence outside public tasks.

TASK-179570341800 returned HTTP 404 and TASK-179570341801 was refused by the host publication check. Under valid ownership, look for an equivalent finished verdict or committed first-party evidence within the existing Algora mission allowance. Do not retry or bypass either refusal. If existing evidence identifies a live, paid documentation task and supports contributor eligibility, verify one original maintainer issue within scope, execute one offline acceptance check, and prepare the exact unsent submission. Otherwise save the coverage gap and the specific first-party evidence that would reopen this route. Read back the committed result and close using the actual lease and a lesson. No external submission.

Use TASK-179570196100 to bind the existing checkout decision to the exact archive members and companion quickstart. Read the underlying grants and reuse any verdict on those hashes. If a grant remains unverified, identify the specific file and evidence needed to reopen redistribution. If the grants and Canadian collection are supported, finish one private listing handoff for the existing tested edition. Under the valid lease for the applicable existing mission, read back the artifact and close with a lesson. No account activation, spending or public release.

Read back the committed result and close with a lesson under your actual lease.

For NORTHERN-CATALOGUE-PILOT-FIT, reuse any finished verdict. If the official Shopify partner profile commits and fits the existing allowance, check who supplied its claims and whether it gives concrete evidence of catalogue or product-data work and an authorized business contact route. Advance CATALOGUE-INQUIRY-USABILITY under a valid lease. First compare the existing catalogue buyer-request-path source-check with the exact served capture from TASK-179570700202. Reuse an equivalent completed check if it covers these bytes and both languages. Otherwise use the queued director-live-link-inventory.json if it commits, verify the relevant wording against the original HTML, and write one bilingual copy-and-paste example that a prospect could form using only the visible instructions. Compare it with an attachment or URL example and identify any missing information the operator would need for scoping. Use actual documented intake limits and distinguish what a prospect can compose from what a mail client or the operator can deliver. Stage a narrow correction only for a reproducible gap. Read back committed evidence and close with a lesson under the actual lease. No test email or deployment.

For NORTHERN-CATALOGUE-PILOT-FIT, use director-profile-workflow-excerpts.json if committed and reuse any finished verdict. Confirm the relevant claims and business route in their original context under the existing mission's source allowance and a valid lease. If the evidence supports fit, finish the copy-ready bilingual pilot inquiry and bind it to the verified catalogue control and existing operator decision workflow. If it falls short, close the bounded mission after evidence readback and state the specific evidence that would reopen it. Keep the inquiry unsent.

Reuse the current checkout verdict for the exact archive. If an archive member's redistribution grant is unresolved, read the committed result for products/distribution/sqlite-original-regression-exercise/ if available. This is a candidate replacement built without external inputs. Check the three executed controls, verify what it adds compared with the exact free release, and identify which archive member it can actually replace. If the existing archive already clears its rights check, use it. Preserve the existing seller and payout evidence requirements, keep the listing private, and close only after reading committed evidence under the actual lease with a lesson.

For the existing SQLite training buyer handoff, reuse any completed verdict or exact-draft decision. If the older archive's redistribution grant is unresolved, check private-evaluation-verification.json under products/distribution/sqlite-original-regression-exercise/ once committed. Use the candidate only if the clean extraction passed and its exact contents and redistribution authority are supported. BrainStation's published curriculum uses MySQL, so describe the SQLite exercise as an optional way to teach the SQL aggregation concept. Avoid compatibility claims. If substituting the archive changes the offer, verify the revised exact draft before routing it once for an operator decision. Keep it unsent. Under a valid lease, read back the finished packet or the precise unresolved prerequisite and close with a lesson.

Take the original SQLite training exercise packaging repair. Reuse any existing repair and coordinate with its owner if already assigned. TASK-179571062800 observed the expected case failures for global-join and distinct-sum, but EXISTS exited 2 and the receipt has no archive hash. Read the committed receipt and actual stderr or invocation before changing anything. Repair the specific cause, run all three modes from a fresh extraction of the exact candidate archive, and require exits 1/1/0 with the expected named failing cases and no failing EXISTS cases. Commit the archive hash and member provenance alongside the run evidence. Route the verified package evidence to BUYER_ROUTE and MARKETPLACE_CHECKOUT only if it passes. Keep the package private and report any unresolved redistribution authority separately from execution.

Reuse any committed successful clean-extraction receipt for the original SQLite exercise. If the latest committed receipt still has exit 2 for EXISTS, inspect its captured stderr and reproduce the documented command from an empty directory before correcting the specific failure. Use only the original synthetic exercise files. Verify the packaged entry point with all five case outcomes and expected exits 1/1/0, record exact archive and member hashes, and document the source of every member and any evidenced redistribution grant. Hand the verified result or exact remaining gap to BUYER_ROUTE. Under your existing valid lease, close the bounded work after reading the committed evidence and include a lesson. Keep the package private and leave publication to independent review.
